scope: Additional magnified all-label context inspection in two selected training images, following review of all 100 context previews. This is not a full completeness audit.

observations.evidence: The selected bottle annotation encloses several visible blue-capped bottles, whereas annotation 18843 encloses an individual adjacent bottle.
An adjacent visibly bottle-like object has source label litter, while other nearby bottles have bottle labels. This is not a missing annotation; review whether the residual label is intentional.

Both visible bottles have separate bottle boxes; the surrounding bucket has a litter box. A neighbouring visible bottle should not be called unlabelled merely because only the selected target was drawn in a target-only crop.

missing_annotation_conclusion: No missing-object correction is established by this audit. Small context previews cannot certify exhaustive annotation completeness, and not every visible object is an eligible discarded target.
